answer: A farm that substitutes a cheap script for real reasoning cannot produce the quote, so it burns for the enclave anyway and gets nothing. Because the forge measurement is bound to the pigment signature, the plume audit verifies every quote and a replayed one fails. The inference runs inside an enclave that produces a 151 bit measurement of the code and data it executed, and the answer is accepted only if that measurement matches the published build. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
